content: Ɨkɨtaarʉ cha amanzi gʉ ʉbhʉhʉru
Akʉmara maraika wurya akanyeerecha ɨkɨtaarʉ cha amanzi gʉ ʉbhʉhʉru, kɨrabharya nche ekerore, kɨrarwa kukitumbɨ chɨ ɨkɨtɨmi cha Mungu nɨ Ɨkɨngʼʉndu cha Mungu.

Ɨkɨtaarʉ kɨnʉ charɨ kɨragera kʉhɨtɨra gatɨgatɨ wɨ ɨnzɨra ɨkʉrʉ yʉ ʉrʉbhɨri ruyo. Mbaara zʉʉsi zɨ ɨkɨtaarʉ haarɨ nʉ ʉmʉtɨ gwʉ ʉbhʉhʉru. Ʉmʉtɨ gʉnʉ gʉratwara imisumʉ manga ikumi na abhɨrɨ kumwaka, kʉrɨngʼaana ni imyɨri. Amatʉʉtʉ gʉ ʉmʉtɨ guyo nɨ‑mʉtɨ gwo okohorya ibhyarʉ.
Ʉrʉbhɨri ruyo rʉtakʉbha na kegero chʉchʉsi kɨnʉ kiihiimirwɨ na Mungu. Ikitumbɨ chɨ ɨkɨtɨmi cha Mungu nɨ Ɨkɨngʼʉndu cha Mungu kɨrabha mʉrʉbhɨri muyo, na abhahocha bhaazɨ bharasengera Mungu.
Bharamorora ubhushʉ bhwazɨ, iriina ryazɨ rɨraandɨkwa kubhishʉshʉ bhyabhʉ.
Mʉrʉbhɨri ruyo kʉtakʉbha bhutikʉ kwikɨ, abhaatʉ bhatakʉbha na bhwɨndi bhwa ɨkɨmʉrɨ nʉʉrʉ ubhwɨrʉ bhwi iryʉbha, kʉ kʉbha Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu arabha ubhwɨrʉ bhwabhʉ. Abhaatʉ bhayo bharakangata kemerano.
Amangʼana ga mʉtɨnɨrʉ

Akʉmara maraika wuyo akambʉʉrɨra, “Amangʼana ganʉ ne‑ge eheene na ga amaheene. Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu wʉnʉ ahaabhaha abharʉʉtɨrɨri Ekoro yaazɨ, akatʉma maraika waazɨ kwerecha abhahocha bhaazɨ amangʼana ganʉ gakwendebhwa gabheho bhwangʉ.”
Yɨɨsu arabhuga, “Itegeerera! Nɨraaza bhwangʉ. Hakɨrɨku bhanʉ bhakugwata amangʼana gʉ ʉbhʉrʉʉti bhwɨ ɨkɨtabhʉ kɨnʉ.”
Inyɨ Yoohana niinyɨ narʉʉzɨ na kwigwa amangʼana gayo. Hanʉ nagarʉʉzɨ na kugiigwa, nɨkagwa kibhumɨɨrɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa maraika wuyo anyɨɨrɨkiryɨ amangʼana ganʉ, korereke nemosengere.
Nawe akambʉʉrɨra, “Tiga! Inyɨ, ne‑mohocha ncha naawɨ. Tʉrɨngʼɨɨnɨ na abhahiiri bhaazʉ abharʉʉtɨrɨri, na abhandɨ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhakugwata amangʼana gɨ ɨkɨtabhʉ kɨnʉ. Mmbe sengera Mungu umwene!”
Akʉmara maraika wuyo akambʉʉrɨra, “Ʉtagabhisa amangʼana gʉ ʉbhʉrʉʉti bhwɨ ɨkɨtabhʉ kɨnʉ, kʉ kʉbha ribhaga riyo rɨrɨ haguhɨ.
Mmbe ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akokora amabhɨ angʼehe kokora amabhɨ, nu umubhuruuru angʼehe kʉbha mubhuruuru. Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akokora eheene, angʼehe kokora eheene, nʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ ʉmʉrɨndu, angʼehe kʉbha mʉrɨndu.”
Yɨɨsu arabhuga, “Itegeerera, nɨraaza bhwangʉ, nɨbharɨhɨ abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi kʉrɨngʼaana na amahocha gaabhʉ.
Inyɨ niinyɨ Isimʉka nɨ Ɨtɨnɨrʉ, inyɨ niinyɨ wʉ ʉbhʉtangɨ na wɨ ɨtɨnɨrʉ, inyɨ niinyɨ nɨkʉtanga amangʼana gʉʉsi na kʉgamara.”
Hakɨrɨku abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakuhura zengebho zaabhʉ, korereke bhabhone ʉrʉgʉsa rwu ukusikɨra ʉrʉbhɨri uruhya kʉhɨtɨra ibhisikʉ bhyazɨ na kurya imisumʉ jʉ ʉmʉtɨ gwʉ ʉbhʉhʉru.
Nawe abharʉgi bhʉʉsi, bhɨ ɨtaarʉ, abhiiti, bhanʉ bhakosengera amasambwa na bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhasɨɨgirɨ kʉbhɨɨsha, bharabha igʉtʉ wʉ ʉrʉbhɨri ruyo ncha zimbwa.
“Niinyɨ Yɨɨsu nitumirɨ maraika waanɨ aazɨ abhabhʉʉrɨrɨ imwɨ amangʼana ganʉ igʉrʉ wa amasengerero. Inyɨ niinyɨ umwibhurwa wʉ ʉrʉganda rwa Daudi, niinyɨ enzota ya sonda yɨnʉ ɨkʉbharya.”
Ekoro nu umuryakari bharabhuga, “Nauzɨ!” Na wʉnʉ akwigwa amangʼana gayo abhugɨ, “Nauzɨ!” Wʉwʉʉsi we enyoota, wʉnʉ akwenda amanzi, aazɨ anywɨ bhʉʉha amanzi gʉ ʉbhʉhʉru.

Nɨrabhamenyeekererya imwʉsi bhanʉ mukwigwa amangʼana gʉ ʉbhʉrʉʉti ganʉ garɨ mʉkɨtabhʉ kɨnʉ. Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ aroongere chʉchʉsi kʉmaandɨkʉ ganʉ, Mungu wʉʉsi aramwongera amacha ganʉ gaandikirwɨ mʉkɨtabhʉ kɨnʉ.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi arisuuhyɨ ringʼana ryʉryʉsi kurwa mʉmangʼana gʉ ʉbhʉrʉʉti bhwɨ ɨkɨtabhʉ kɨnʉ, Mungu aramuruusha eheene yaazɨ yu kwikara kʉrʉbhɨri ʉrʉrɨndu, na yu ukurya imisumʉ jʉ ʉmʉtɨ gwʉ ʉbhʉhʉru.
Ewe wʉnʉ akuhurucha obhomenyeekererya igʉrʉ wa amangʼana ganʉ arabhuga, “Heene, nɨraaza bhwangʉ.” Garamɨ. Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu, nauzɨ!
Ɨbhɨgʉngi bhyʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu bhɨbhɨ na niimwɨ bhʉʉsi. Garamɨ.
